title: KVComm: Enabling Efficient LLM Communication through Selective KV Sharing
authors: Xiangyu Shi; Marco Chiesa; Gerald Q. Maguire Jr.; Dejan Kostić

problem_statement.en: Natural-language inter-LLM communication requires costly decoding steps and can discard information during sampling, while hidden-state protocols concentrate information in the final token and transfer too little activation state. Multi-agent systems therefore need an effective communication medium that reduces sender computation and transmission without sacrificing task quality.
problem_statement.zh: 以自然語言進行 inter-LLM communication 需要成本高昂的多步 decoding，且可能在 sampling 過程中遺失資訊；hidden-state protocol 又會使資訊集中於最後一個 token，僅能傳遞有限的 activation state。因此，multi-agent system 需要在不犧牲任務品質的前提下，降低 sender 運算與傳輸成本的有效 communication medium。

key_innovation.en: KVComm prefills the sender context, scores layers using query-to-context attention mass plus a Gaussian middle-layer prior, and transmits only the top-scoring, potentially non-contiguous layers' KV pairs. The receiver concatenates them into the corresponding attention layers during prefill and decoding.
key_innovation.zh: KVComm 對 sender context 執行 prefill，以 query-to-context attention mass 與以中間 layer 為中心的 Gaussian prior 計算 layer 分數，僅傳輸得分最高且可不連續的 layers 之 KV pairs；receiver 在對應 attention layer 的 prefill 與 decoding 階段串接這些 KV pairs。

baselines_compared: Baseline (no communication), Skyline, NLD, CIPHER, AC, Random selection

key_improvements.en: KVComm reduces computation cost by 2.5x to 6x relative to Skyline and communication cost by up to 3x relative to transmitting every layer's KV pairs, while retaining comparable task performance.
key_improvements.zh: KVComm 相較 Skyline 將運算成本降低 2.5x 至 6x，並相較傳輸所有 layers 的 KV pairs 將 communication cost 最高降低 3x，同時維持相近的任務表現。

reuse_metric.en: Comparable to the Skyline upper bound while transmitting as few as 30% of layers' KV pairs; up to 3x lower communication cost than transmitting every layer.
reuse_metric.zh: 僅傳輸少至 30% layers 的 KV pairs，即可達到與 Skyline 上界相近的表現；相較傳輸所有 layers，communication cost 最高降低 3x。
